title: Siralim native family map: every inventory, semantic split and inherited unread row

reviews.classification: full actual native-map review; raw table/native and parent-gap qualifications preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all5174JSON lines through the exact factored header/dictionaries,15routing blocks and every SU-I001–SU-I146 record. Every original inventory_columns/source line/native address, evidence/new-read list, prior/origin/status/deep-section, kit/packet/topic/coverage/gap and remaining field was read. The [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/siralim-family-view-receipt-b593.json) and [lossless reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/siralim-family-lossless-view-b593.json) reconstruct the original JSON exactly. Source SHAddb8d9edc483c053891be3e166e0ca9e7f370bd1e2619cb53fd2820597ebe2f6 remains unchanged; build20548371/finalized2026-10-15 is the historical evidence pin, not fresh installation or upstream verification.

F2:146records=102prior-inventory+36semantic-splits+8prior-unread.100inventoried-body-unread+17partial-native+21text/prior-native-partial+8partial also sum146. These overlap source families and selected D01–D15 leaves; they are not146independent mechanisms or complete source semantics. Header18additional+15prior returned native outputs are33returned artifacts, not33fully decoded normal/failure/whole-save flows. A deep_section pointer on an unread row is navigation, not a source-body closure. All raw CSVs/native functions/private receipts remain outside this new review.

F3: Preserve localisation/table rows versus executable consumers across accessories, achievements, battle/boss/cards, codex/creature/item/dialogue/lore, decoration/project/quest/personality/skin/spell/perk/trait/UI/vocabulary. Counts of lines and selected IDs are not distinct live entities, reachable offers, full translation or a playable collection. Battle230/event46/reaction13symbols overlap rather than add; SCPT/OBJT/native script-object indexes include wrappers/libraries and are not mechanic counts. inventory_columns retains parsed original cells, including regex alternatives split across strings for macros/realm/GMLive patterns; do not infer independent numeric columns or extra systems from that shape. Scribble/GMLive/parser presence is not a selected UI dependency or player mod API.

F4: Preserve D01target knowledge/rank/recruitment versus actual access, D02active project capacity/mission completion, D03salvage/upgrade/socket/inscription, D04personality/growth/speech, D05fusion/identity versus breeding remnants, D06experimental recipe versus actual reachable discovery and D07placement/speech versus autonomous residents. D08favor/currency/blessing, D09rune/risk/anointment, D10prophecy/turn-in/relic/attunement, D11distinct membership/duplicate/synergy/achievement/piety/streak, D12mastery/depth/specialization/key and D13quest/dialogue/flags/free-play occurrence are different source questions. A named database for Breeding, an AddTrait global helper, custom NPC speech or one realm template does not establish a reachable breeding loop, creature cap, society or complete generator.

F5: D14macro legal action, arena temporary draft, filters and minigame odds retain actual command/custody/disclosure distinctions. D15paired Creature/Project/Decoration encoders and decoders qualify3of9helpers each direction only; six other domains, scalar defaults, whole-save Step/completion/publication, recovery and failed loading remain open. SU-I135/I136 partial_native describes selected save-related evidence, not completed whole-save atomicity or offline/calendar/aging semantics. A wrapper/Create async setup or file copy is not crash-safe final commit. The timed-out261492byte-span object is a bounded extraction gap, not a function semantically read or permission to rerun the monolith.

F6: SU-I139–146 retain U1–U8 parent gaps: all30realm joins, exact fusion admission/payment/rounding/custody, trait dispatch/reset/exemption, whole-save fields/publication, corrupt/migration/backup recovery, complete dialogue/speakers/relationships, all side-game/collection/crafting/loot odds, and native controls/save/society proof. No map pointer can close them. Target-acquisition, experimental-discovery, synergy and side-game dedicated-owner gaps remain scoped broad-home inferences, not a new framework mandate. Current PROJECT and AD22/AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 qualify donor caps/once rules, human review and current build sequence. No source game, raw table/native body, private state, extraction, browser/build/test, worker, migration, acquisition, deletion, commit or push occurred. Original JSON/schema, useful ideas and partial history remain intact.
reviews.evidence: All146rows in three bounded lossless outputs plus full header/dictionaries/15routing blocks; exact reconstruction/source identity in siralim-family-view-receipt-b593.json.
reviews.reopen: For a selected consumer inspect actual native/semantic route rather than count or section pointer; all U1–U8 limits retained.
